title: Inside Knight Transportation’s Tulare Terminal: Where Communication Drives Success
summary: Discover Knight Transportation's Tulare Terminal, featuring flexible California freight, a supportive culture, and one of Knight's largest trainer fleets.
body_markdown:
If you’re looking for[trucking driving jobs in California](https://www.knighttrans.com/jobs/) or searching for the best trucking terminal in Northern California, there’s one place that stands above the rest – the Tulare Terminal at[Knight Transportation](https://www.knighttrans.com/) .


Home to one of the largest trainer fleets in the Knight network, Tulare offers experienced drivers the opportunity to grow their careers while helping develop the next generation of professional drivers.


Beyond its strong training program, the terminal has become a popular stop for Knight drivers traveling south from the Pacific Northwest or north from Southern California. Its convenient location and welcoming environment make it a place drivers are proud to call home.


Watch the video below to meet the Tulare team and home-based drivers who call Tulare home. Hear firsthand how strong communication, teamwork, and support set this terminal apart.


## A Culture Built on Communication


One of the biggest themes highlighted throughout our[Tulare Terminal](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/tulare-ca/) video is the team’s commitment to communication.


At Tulare, leaders believe strong relationships begin with accessibility. Through an open-door approach and a culture built on trust and respect, drivers are encouraged to speak up, ask questions, and stay connected with their support teams.


In trucking, communication is everything. Whether it’s a load update, a breakdown on the road, or simply checking in, staying connected helps ensure drivers feel supported every step of the way.


For the Tulare operations team, those conversations go beyond freight and logistics. They focus on building genuine relationships with drivers.


Those lasting connections speak to the culture in Tulare.


The operations team is committed to supporting drivers both on and off the road because, at Knight, people come first.


> "In this industry, you have to have a lot of communication. Text messages, phone calls. I have drivers that call me just to talk and I have drivers I've communicated with for the past five years who no longer work for Knight Transportation. That's the kind of relationship I build with my drivers."
>
>
> Ryan Adams, Tulare Driver Manager


## Unmatched Amenities for Drivers


While truck driver support, communication, and relationships are at the heart of the Tulare Terminal, the facility itself is designed to support drivers both on and off the road.


The terminal offers a variety of amenities, including:


- Driver lounge
- Free laundry
- Showers
- Truck maintenance support
- Wi-Fi
- Coffee station
- Outdoor BBQ area
- Pet area
- Truck and trailer wash
- Picnic tables and more


These resources help drivers recharge, relax, and prepare for their next trip while away from home.


## Closer Look Into Tulare's Amenities


## A Small-Town Feel with Big Opportunities


Since opening in 2005, the[Tulare Terminal](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/tulare-ca/) has fostered a welcoming, family-oriented atmosphere that sets it apart.


Monthly BBQs, regular driver interactions, and a family-friendly culture all contribute to what many drivers describe as a true home-terminal experience.


While Tulare maintains a small-town fleet, it offers big opportunities. With a fleet of approximately 165 trucks and plans to grow to 180 by year-end, drivers can choose a variety of routes and career paths across California and beyond.


Supporting drivers at the terminal each day are the DQP Coordinator and Yard Manager, who help keep operations running smoothly and provide drivers with local, hands-on support.


In addition, the Terminal Manager and Operations team regularly visit from Phoenix, giving drivers access to resources and assistance from both locations. This collaborative approach helps ensure drivers always have a team ready to support them.


## OnSite Shop Support


One thing that makes Tulare unique is its[large on-site shop](https://www.knighttrans.com/shop-careers/) . As one of Knight’s largest maintenance facilities in a small-town setting, it gives drivers convenient access to experienced technicians and comprehensive maintenance support, helping keep equipment in top condition and reducing downtime.


The terminal features:


- An inspection lane
- A full-service maintenance shop
- Multiple service bays, including tire bays, service pits, and dry bays


At Knight, safety is one of our top priorities. Our shop teams work hard to service trucks quickly and thoroughly, helping minimize downtime while maximizing drivers’ earning potential.


Their goal is to ensure every driver leaves with properly maintained equipment, road-ready, and prepared for the miles ahead.


> "Even though I don't own this truck or lease it, I take pride and ownership like it's mine. I'm always going to make sure it's serviced and taken care of, and my guy is always going to get me in and take care of any detail or problem."
>
>
> Tony Rangel, Million Miler Driver


## Largest Trainer Fleet in the Knight Network


The Tulare Terminal is home to one of the largest trainer fleets in the Knight network and is always looking for experienced, safety-minded drivers to help train the next generation of professionals.


[Becoming a trainer](https://www.knighttrans.com/become-a-trainer/) offers benefits beyond the road, including:


- Increased earning potential
- Leadership and coaching experience
- A stronger professional resume
- The opportunity to mentor new drivers
- Lasting friendships and connections
- Greater flexibility and career growth opportunities


**The average annual pay for a trainer ranges from $70,000 to $80,000, while top-performing trainers earn more than $120,000 per year.**


Trainer Josh Howley says, “I became a trainer because when I first started, I didn’t have a trainer. I had to figure everything else on my own, and I believe that set me back in my career. I wanted to do what I could to make sure other people didn’t have to go through the same thing.”


If you’re passionate about helping others succeed and want to take the next step in your trucking career, becoming a trainer is a rewarding way to make a lasting impact while growing both professionally and financially.


## Freight Opportunities That Fit Your Lifestyle


For many drivers,[freight variety](https://www.knighttrans.com/jobs/) matters as much as terminal culture. Tulare offers multiple route options, giving drivers the flexibility to choose the lanes and schedules that best fit their goals.


Drivers based out of Tulare can choose from several operating styles, including:


- 48-state OTR
- Triangle routes
- Western 11
- I-5 corridor runs
- And more


With freight moving in multiple directions, drivers can find opportunities that align with their preferred lifestyle while maintaining consistent miles.


## Why Drivers Choose Tulare


Nonetheless, what makes Tulare special isn’t just the freight, amenities, or location. It’s the people.


From driver managers who build lasting relationships to shop technicians who treat every truck like it’s their own, the Tulare team is committed to helping drivers succeed.


Whether you’re looking for flexible California freight opportunities, a supportive leadership team, growth as a trainer, or a terminal that genuinely values its drivers, Tulare offers an environment where you can succeed both professionally and personally.


Together, these qualities – strong communication, an open-door culture, driver-focused amenities, and career growth opportunities – make the[Knight Transportation](https://www.knighttrans.com/) Tulare Terminal a place where drivers can truly experience what it means to Deliver More.


## Watch the Tulare Terminal Video


Altogether, the best way to understand the Tulare culture is to hear directly from the drivers, leaders, and team members who live it every day.


Watch the[Tulare Terminal video](https://youtu.be/hMuENrndP9E) to learn more about the people, opportunities, and support that make the Tulare Terminal a place drivers are proud to call home.


Whether you’re exploring truck driving careers in Tulare, California, considering becoming a trainer, or simply wanting a closer look at life at Knight Transportation, we invite you to watch the full video and hear their stories firsthand.
